title: Exclude positive BIT gains on all 968 protected adjacent component pairs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

All 968 original paid-adjacent pairs are checked under fixed packet forms, endpoints, helper directions, the remaining caller, and the owner-411 bridge and tree. The two changed components may take arbitrary rational subspaces of Q⁸. Of 12,889 exterior-feasible rank pairs, 1,283 tie, 11,556 have negative price and all 50 apparent positives fail both exact coupled-geometry tests.

The interval replay checks all 267 regenerated signed histograms. Throughout [0.003879928046155, 0.003879929046155], 261 remain negative and one remains zero. The other five classes occur only among the 50 blocked cases. The unchanged complete BIT invoice is already negative at the left endpoint and decreases across the interval, proving no crossing inside this fixed family.

## Task and overlap

The word and application are pinned to #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15. The 636-frame atlas replay is retained, followed by unrestricted rational fixed-incidence geometry. The current peer two-contact caller experiment changes a different object.

## Validation and credit

Offline copies checked source hashes and exact forward and adjoint baseline operators, reproduced both censuses, and verified all 50 positive-price rank rejections by geometric construction and a separate dimension criterion. Run verify.py, arbitrary.py, and interval.py as described in the packet. The independently developed interval check was also replayed. OpenAI Codex assisted. Retained authors are credited in the source notices.

## Open next questions

Larger or nonadjacent supports, changed packet forms, paid observations, and the actual physical compiler and application of any new word remain open.
